name: hoplix
description: Print-on-demand with Hoplix: browse the catalogue, create campaigns with your designs, quote and place orders that Hoplix prints and ships, and track them.

defaultPrompt: Which hoodies can I print on with Hoplix and how much do they cost?
How much does it cost to ship 2 t-shirts from my campaign to Naples, Italy?

positive.description: Browse the catalogue: hoodies with base costs
positive.prompt: Which hoodies does Hoplix offer and how much do they cost printed on the front only and on front and back?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Hoplix hoodie products (for example felpa-unisex-con-capuccio, Unisex Hoodie) with colours, sizes and the base cost for front print (base-cost) and for front and back print (base-cost-back) in EUR.

positive.prompt: Show me my Hoplix campaigns with their selling prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the campaigns of the test account: Hoplix Rocket Tee, Hoplix Rocket Hoodie and Team merch (private), each with its products, selling price and colours.

positive.description: Quote an order without placing it
positive.prompt: How much would it cost to send 2 white Hoplix Rocket Tee in size M to Anna Bianchi, Via Toledo 100, 80134 Napoli (NA), Italy, with economy shipping? Don't order yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the campaign to get its product-id, then returns the total and the shipping cost in EUR for 2 t-shirts with economy shipping to Italy. No order is created and nothing is charged.

positive.prompt: Place a TEST order with reference REVIEW-TEST-2 for 1 black Hoplix Rocket Hoodie in size L, shipped tracked to Anna Bianchi, Via Toledo 100, 80134 Napoli (NA), Italy.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the quote, asks for confirmation, then calls create_order with test=true and returns a TEST-... order id with total and shipping cost, stating that a test order is only validated and priced and is never produced or charged. If REVIEW-TEST-2 was already used, it reports that the reference already exists.

positive.prompt: Show my Hoplix test orders and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_orders with test=true and lists the test orders of the account, including the one with reference REVIEW-DEMO-1, with status Pending.

negative.description: Payment is never made from the chat
negative.prompt: Pay my last Hoplix order with my saved credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not attempt any payment: the plugin has no payment tool. Explains that orders are paid by the seller from the Orders page of the Hoplix account or from the payment link sent by email.
Does not act: there is no tool to delete campaigns. Explains that campaigns are managed from the Hoplix account.

negative.description: No access to other sellers' data
negative.prompt: Show me the orders and customers of the Hoplix seller with id 70.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not return data of other accounts: every tool only works on the signed-in account. Explains that it can only show the user's own orders.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: catalogue, campaigns, quotes, orders created unpaid (paid on Hoplix), test orders, order status and tracking, cancellation of orders not yet in production.
